metadata.notes: Every place in this file exists in OpenStreetMap with its own coordinates. No entry was invented and no entry is a demo. Where an entry has no opening hours it says "hours not listed"; where it has no name it says "name not mapped". The Open-now filter counts only entries whose hours are known. Rebuild with: node tools/fetch-osm.mjs && node tools/build-locations.mjs
